allow: PowerShell(try { Invoke-WebRequest "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/springframework/ai/spring-ai-starter-model-openai/1.0.0/spring-ai-starter-model-openai-1.0.0.pom" -Method Head -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object StatusCode } catch { $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode })

PowerShell(Invoke-RestMethod "https://search.maven.org/solrsearch/select?q=g:org.springframework.ai+AND+v:1.0.0&rows=50&wt=json&start=0" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty response | Select-Object -ExpandProperty docs | Select-Object -ExpandProperty a | Where-Object { $_ -match "core|chat|client" } | Sort-Object)
PowerShell(docker run --rm -v "${env:TEMP}:/jars" eclipse-temurin:17-jdk-jammy bash -c "jar tf /jars/mcp-sdk.jar | grep 'McpClient\\|McpSyncClient\\|CallTool\\|SseClient' | head -20")
